stories.title: Family remembers Jennily Srang, 6-year-old killed in Stockton shooting
stories.summary: The Stockton Unified School District is mourning the loss of Jennily Srang, a first grader at August School who was killed in a shooting Tuesday afternoon.

stories.title: Roads to close for Sacramento’s Run to Feed the Hungry 2026 | Here's where
stories.summary: Road closures for the Thanksgiving run in East Sacramento will last until about noon, the city said. The 10K run begins at 8:15 a.m.; the 5K starts at 9 a.m.

stories.title: Suspect killed in Antelope deputy-involved shooting identified
stories.summary: The Sacramento County Coroner's Office identified the suspect killed in a shooting with deputies in Antelope as 29-year-old Alvin Horton of San Francisco.

stories.title: One child dead, one injured in Stockton shooting, police say
stories.summary: A 6-year-old girl died and an 11-year-old boy suffered a graze wound following a shooting Tuesday afternoon in Stockton, police said.

stories.title: Sacramento Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Flooding concerns for the Delta and near the deep water channel in West Sacramento due to coastal King Tides. Chance of overnight showers then clearing Wednesday.

stories.title: 7 arrested in connection with $1 million Yuba City jewelry store heist
stories.summary: Seven people have been arrested in connection with a July jewelry store burglary in Yuba City, where police say more than $1 million in merchandise was stolen.

stories.title: New year, new laws: How California Democrats took on federal immigration enforcement
stories.summary: Several laws targeting federal immigration enforcement are set to take effect in January, while others face challenges in federal court.

stories.title: Jason Lee to resign from Stockton City Council
stories.summary: Councilmember Jason Lee announced he will resign from his position on the Stockton City Council effective Jan. 31, 2027

stories.title: Two men arrested in Stanislaus County telecommunications wire theft investigation
stories.summary: Two Turlock men were arrested in an investigation into AT&T wire thefts that caused hundreds of thousands of dollars in damage.

stories.title: Sacramento Zoo's beloved okapi Moki dies after months of medical complications
stories.summary: Moki was just over a year old when he died despite months of treatment and efforts by Sacramento Zoo veterinary staff to save him.

stories.title: Yuba City man sentenced to more than 9 years in human trafficking case
stories.summary: A Yuba City man was sentenced to nine years and four months in prison after pleading guilty to human trafficking of a minor and felony child abuse.

stories.title: 'This is only round one' | Supporters of failed Prop. 40 'billionaire tax' vow to keep fighting, including a possible second attempt in 2028
stories.summary: Despite voters' rejection of Proposition 40, the union behind it vows to renew efforts to tax billionaires.
